messages.content: What is the effect of economic status on happiness levels?

function.name: get_happiness_index
function.description: Fetches the happiness index for a given country or area based on data compiled from global surveys. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The country for which to retrieve the happiness index.

year.description: The year for which to retrieve the happiness index.

demographic_group.description: The demographic group for which to retrieve the happiness index. If not specified, the total for all groups will be returned.

message.content: Economic status—often measured by income level or wealth—has a strong and consistent influence on happiness. People with higher incomes tend to report higher life satisfaction and well‑being, but the relationship is not linear. In many countries, the biggest gains in happiness come when moving from low to middle income; beyond that, additional income yields diminishing returns. This pattern reflects the fact that basic needs and security are strongly linked to well‑being, while extra money mainly provides comfort and choice rather than fundamental changes in life quality.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the effect of economic status on happiness levels?" They want an answer. We can provide a general explanation. No tool needed.
